# Proof of control for corpus-pnone.example
# Method: self_owned (docs/09-ownership-verification.md)
#
# This is not a real domain. `.example` is reserved by RFC 2606 and can never
# be registered by anyone, so there is no third party to harm and no zone to
# prove control of.
#
# It is a synthetic corpus zone, generated by:
#     uv run python -m corpus.generators.email
# and frozen at:
#     corpus/fixtures/email/dmarc-monitoring-only/
#
# It is listed explicitly rather than exempted implicitly, because
# docs/09 allows no implicit exemptions - not even for something we authored
# ourselves. The row exists so that the audit trail is complete.
